thread:
amelia: FYI customer #2541 hitting intermittent decrypt 403s when routing to their on-prem HSM pool. Errors show up after sustained load (~6-10m). They reported a billing spike at the same time. attaching logs below.
support-bot: Ticket created: SUP-2541. Priority: high. Customer: LegalPayments Inc. Region: eu-west-1.
josh: Can you paste the agent/HSM logs? firmware + HSM model? Also want a short repro if possible.
amelia: HSM vendor: nCipher, model: nShield-2000, firmware 2.14.1. Short log excerpt attached. Repro: run our loadgen against their route with 45 concurrent sessions for ~8 minutes and you'll see failures.
krishna: quick scan shows repeated lines: `EVICT_KEY id=0x7f9c reason=lock_timeout` followed by `DECRYPT_FAIL code=403 session=0x12345`. Also TLS reconnects around same timestamps.
amelia: here's the log snippet:
```
2026-03-02T15:18:42Z hsm-agent[2321]: session_open id=0x12345 user=svc-redwood
2026-03-02T15:18:42Z hsm-agent[2321]: DECRYPT start key=kv-88 seq=45
2026-03-02T15:18:50Z hsm-agent[2321]: EVICT_KEY id=0x7f9c reason=lock_timeout
2026-03-02T15:18:50Z hsm-agent[2321]: DECRYPT_FAIL code=403 key=kv-88 retry=1
2026-03-02T15:18:51Z hsm-agent[2321]: tls: connection reset by peer
```
josh: Hmm, eviction on lock timeout suggests concurrency limits on the HSM's key handle table. Could also be long-running ops holding locks and causing others to get evicted.
maria: Customer also called out an unexpected billing jump during the same window — likely our API retries produced duplicate chargeable tokens. @finance FYI: invoice snippet in ticket.
krishna: Immediate mitigations I suggest:
- throttle concurrency to HSM pool (client-side), add exponential backoff
- add idempotency token enforcement for decrypt calls
- temporarily route critical decrypts to software-backed KMS variant for the customer until we confirm hardware stability
We need to capture raw HSM audit records for compliance — preserve audit logs for 90 days per their contract.
amelia: Can we get an oncall from eng-runtime to confirm whether our HSM connection pool is leaking handles? Also need to decide whether to failover to cloud HSM for the affected customer.
josh: I'm going to reproduce locally with a small script. Repro snippet:
```
# quick repro (do not run against prod)
seq 1 500 | xargs -n1 -P50 -I{} curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/decrypt \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"ciphertext":"...","idempotency_key":"repro-{}"}'
```
sre-bot: Alert: 7 decrypt_failures for customer LegalPayments in last 10m. Escalating to eng-oncall.
krishna: Long-term fix: firmware 2.15.0 includes improved key-handle reclamation. Recommend scheduling vendor firmware upgrade and increasing handle table size if vendor supports it. Also add observability for handle usage metrics in console.
maria: Compliance note: legal needs HSM audit bundle for Mar 2 15:00-16:00 UTC. Amelia, add bundle to ticket and set retention flag.
amelia: Added audit bundle link to SUP-2541 and asked for temporary routing change. Customer accepted software fallback for 30m for business continuity.
josh: For engineering: I'll open an internal bug with steps to reproduce + logs. tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml for kernel/driver review.
support-bot: SUP-2541 updated: mitigation applied (software fallback), awaiting firmware schedule. Assigned: eng-runtime oncall.
krishna: One more thing — add a short-term change to the client SDK: add jittered backoff and reduce default concurrency from 64 to 16 for on-prem HSM pools. That should reduce immediate eviction pressure.
amelia: Noted. I'll coordinate patch with devex and push a small SDK release under the client-hotfix flag.
maria: Finance: customer billing adjusted after support investigation; created billing-incident CHG-789 and refunded duplicated charges. @finance please confirm final amount.
josh: Next steps summary: 1) eng-runtime to confirm handle leak or misconfig. 2) devex SDK hotfix for backoff+concurrency. 3) schedule firmware upgrade with vendor. 4) provide legal with audit bundle and 90d retention confirmation. 5) close SUP-2541 when all verified.
amelia: Thanks everyone. I'll keep updates in SUP-2541 and ping when we have firmware window.
support: closing loop for now, re-open if failures reappear. :thumbsup:\
